Construct a standardized statistical result frame

Source: R/frame-fit.R
result_frame.Rd

Construct a standardized statistical result frame

Usage

result_frame(
  assays,
  observations,
  features,
  method,
  diagnostics = list(),
  term_data = NULL,
  source_observation_ids = NULL,
  metadata = list(),
  provenance = NULL
)

Arguments

assays

Named observation-by-feature result assays.

observations

Result-row metadata containing stable .obs_id values.

features

The aligned spatial feature axis.

method

Registered statistical reducer name.

diagnostics

Per-feature diagnostics.

term_data

Compiled term metadata.

source_observation_ids

Stable source observation IDs.

metadata

Additional result metadata.

provenance

Serializable derivation provenance.

Value

An fmri_frame marked with a versioned statistical-result schema.
